## VS Evolution Helper (BepInEx) 1.8.0

### Highlights
- **Config** for hover delays and feature toggles (map, stage guide, level-up tooltips)
- **Level Up:** no unsolicited tooltips; requires mouse move then short icon hover
- Stage select Music|Guide, map/grimoire tooltips (from 1.7.x)

### Install
1. **BepInEx 6 IL2CPP** only (not MelonLoader)
2. Extract zip so you get `BepInEx/plugins/VSEvolutionHelper/VSEvolutionHelper.dll`
3. Close the game before updating the DLL

### Config (after first run)
`BepInEx/config/com.nihil.vsevolutionhelper.cfg`
- Tooltips.HoverDelay, LevelUpHoverDelay, ControllerDwellDelay
- Features.MapTooltips, StageGuide, StageGuideDefaultToGuide, LevelUpTooltips
